audit.scope: Pummelchen/ChatBots only (workspace siblings are separate repos, owned by other audit sessions)

tasks.title: The website binds every interface and the whole API is unauthenticated
tasks.evidence_before: Caddyfile:27 'http://:7788' (all interfaces); /api/* reverse_proxied at Caddyfile:34; no authn anywhere; tools/start-web-desktop.sh and start-web-mobile.sh start it so; wiki recommends phone access over the LAN
tasks.notes: Owner may raise to S0. Phone access is deliberate; the missing authorisation boundary is not documented.

tasks.title: The core inference path and the installer's smoke test are effectively uncovered
tasks.evidence_before: Sources/ line coverage 71.6%; MLXEngine 2.2%, TransportCheck 0%, OpenAIResponsesEngine 11.0%, WebTools 11.4%, TavilyClient 16.5%, APIServer 60.2% (baseline/coverage-sources.txt)
tasks.notes: The S1 no-turns defect lived in MLXEngine. GPU inference is out of scope; the logic inside it is not.

tasks.title: No warnings-as-errors gate, though the baseline is already 0 warnings
tasks.evidence_before: baseline/swift-build-debug.log and -release.log both 0 warnings, 0 errors; no treatAllWarnings in Package.swift

tasks.title: CI runs no build, test, lint, type-check, scanner or coverage step
tasks.evidence_before: checks.yml has 4 steps: embed-web --check, embed-names --check, bash -n, py_compile
tasks.notes: Hosted runners cannot run the suite (macOS 26 + GPU). Needs self-hosted runner or a written local-only gate.

tasks.title: Four @unchecked Sendable declarations, none with a written justification
tasks.evidence_before: git grep '@unchecked Sendable' -- Sources => DocumentIngestor, HTTPServer, EventStream, ProgressBox
tasks.notes: Forbidden as a fix (§0); pre-existing, so justify or replace.

tasks.title: swiftlint 401 findings and swift-format 29900 diagnostics with no repository config
tasks.evidence_before: baseline/swiftlint.json (line_length 124, trailing_comma 93, identifier_name 33, opening_brace 26, file_length 21, function_body_length 21); baseline/swift-format-lint.txt 29900
tasks.notes: Same class as MCPSearch A02/A03; commit a config encoding the real style.

tasks.title: Python is 3.14 but unannotated and unchecked
tasks.evidence_before: ruff check 11 errors; ruff format --check 5 files; pyright 2 errors (capture-devices.py:303, cdp.py:288)

tasks.title: WebTransport is pinned by range while the project has twice depended on an exact transport behaviour
tasks.evidence_before: Package.swift 'from: "1.3.7"'; the 1.3.7 floor exists because 1.3.6 had a lifetime connection cap
tasks.notes: Decision task: exact pin or a written justification for the range.

tasks.title: SAST: insecure-websocket and dynamic-urllib findings in the dev-only DevTools client
tasks.notes: Loopback DevTools client; low genuine risk. Annotate or guard.

tasks.title: shellcheck -S style reports 24 notes, mostly SC2001
Neither the README nor the wiki states that running the website exposes the API to the LAN
tasks.evidence_before: How-it-works says 'never exposed to the network beyond what you ask for'; Caddy binds all interfaces by default

tasks.title: AddressSanitizer over the whole suite: clean
tasks.evidence_before: no sanitizer baseline exists; ASan attempt in flight at baseline/swift-test-asan.log
tasks.fix_summary: no fix needed — the instrumented run is the deliverable
tasks.evidence_after: swift test --sanitize=address --scratch-path ~/Library/Caches/ChatBots/audit-asan => exit 0, 555 tests in 77 suites passed, no AddressSanitizer report anywhere in the log
tasks.notes: MCPSearchs only S0 was found by this exact command; a clean plain suite proves nothing about that class. Scratch path kept outside Dropbox on purpose.

tasks.title: ThreadSanitizer over the whole suite: one data race found
tasks.fix_summary: no fix here — the finding is opened as A14
tasks.evidence_after: swift test --sanitize=thread --scratch-path ~/Library/Caches/ChatBots/audit-tsan => TSAN_EXIT=1, 555 tests passed, ThreadSanitizer: reported 1 warnings, SUMMARY: data race HTTPServer.swift:356 in closure #2 in HTTPServer.start()
tasks.notes: The suite still passed — which is why the run matters. Expected clean; it was not.

tasks.title: isRunning/lastError are raced between the listener callback and waitUntilReady
tasks.evidence_before: TSan: Write of size 1 at HTTPServer.swift:356 (closure #2 in start(), GCD worker) vs Previous read at HTTPServer.swift:380 (waitUntilReady, concurrency thread); block allocated by APIServer.start() APIServer.swift:350
tasks.notes: Production path: chatbots-cli --serve calls APIServer.waitUntilReady (main.swift:649). Second half of A05 — HTTPServer is one of the four @unchecked Sendable types, and this is the state that conformance assumes needs no protecting. Graded S1 per §7 (unsafe concurrency); owner may call it S0 because a hoisted read would make a healthy server report as not ready.
